三人每包 15 张，每人取 2 张，传过三人后弃 9 张；每人抓 60 张。选入: Three players draft 15-card packs, taking two cards each. After each player sees a pack, discard the remaining nine. Each player drafts 60 cards, chooses any number and adds basic lands to build a deck of at least 60 cards including the commander.

Bracket 是组牌后的体验目标。平均单卡评价与 Cube 数量预算属于本项目: Bracket describes the intended deck experience. Cube-wide limits and average card ratings are project-specific; bracket 3 allows up to three Game Changers per deck, including commander and lands. Brackets 4–5 do not automatically allow fast mana, infinite combos or mass land destruction.

生成器使用整数规划满足数量、曲线、颜色、互动和终结密度；不满足时会报告失败，不会: The solver enforces slot, curve, color, interaction and finisher constraints. If constraints are impossible, it reports an error rather than silently relaxing them.

TXT 中传奇生物自动识别为指挥官槽位。需要精确区分时请使用带 role 列的: Legendary creatures in TXT are assigned to commander slots automatically. Use a CSV with a role column for precise assignments.

测量合法组牌率及前四回合的法术力准备度。没有模拟完整牌效、战斗或胜负，结果不能当: Measures deck-building availability and mana readiness in the first four turns. It does not simulate complete games and is not a win-rate estimate.
自动轮抓、挑选主牌并自由补基本地，组成 60 张牌组（含指挥官）。Forge 原: Draft, select spells and add free basic lands to build 60-card decks including commanders. Forge AI plays the games; seats rotate every three games. Drafting and games run in parallel.
